source: shakiliitju/Bangladesh-Railway — trains_en.json (MIT License, forked from nishatrhythm)
Wikipedia individual train articles for route/stop confirmation
_meta.confidence: High — train numbers and names are confirmed across multiple community sources
_meta.note: Each train has two entries — one per direction. Odd numbers are typically DOWN (away from Dhaka/origin), even numbers are UP (towards Dhaka/origin). Special trains (Eid specials, commuters) are also included. 'model' is the string used in POST /v1.0/web/train-routes API calls.
_meta.off_days_note: Off days are per train and change seasonally. Values here are defaults. Always verify at eticket.railway.gov.bd before launch.
manual_work_required: Verify off_days for each train — BR changes these frequently
Add origin_station_id and destination_station_id once train_stops.json is complete
Confirm route for newly added trains (Cox's Bazar 813/814, Ruposhi Bangla 827/828, Jahanabad 825/826)
_meta.compliance_note: Shohoz reference removed per Part 02.1 — train data traces to permitted sources only.
